result.instructions: Tools for Katana MRP, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which products are below their reorder level, and which locations hold them?"; "List the manufacturing orders that are still in progress and their deadlines."; "Which variants have negative stock right now?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Katana MRP data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run katana_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run katana_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run katana_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. katana_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: katana_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List finished products (name, UoM, sellable/producible/purchasable flags, default supplier). Katana API: GET /products.

tools.name: katana_get_product
tools.title: Get a product
tools.description: Get one product by id, with its recipe-relevant fields. Katana API: GET /products/{id}.

tools.name: katana_list_materials
tools.title: List materials
tools.description: List raw materials (name, category, UoM, batch tracking, default supplier). Katana API: GET /materials.

tools.name: katana_get_material
tools.title: Get a material
tools.description: Get one material by id. Katana API: GET /materials/{id}.

tools.name: katana_list_variants
tools.title: List variants
tools.description: List variants (the stock-keeping level: SKU, sales and purchase price, product or material link). Katana API: GET /variants.

product_id.description: Only variants of this product id.

material_id.description: Only variants of this material id.

sku.description: Filter by one or more SKUs.

tools.name: katana_get_variant
tools.title: Get a variant
tools.description: Get one variant by id, with SKU, prices and classification. Katana API: GET /variants/{id}.

tools.name: katana_list_sales_orders
tools.title: List sales orders
tools.description: List sales orders, most recent first. Filter by order number, customer, location, status or creation window. Katana API: GET /sales_orders.

customer_id.description: Only orders of this customer id.

location_id.description: Only orders at this location id.

status.description: Order status as Katana names it (e.g. NOT_SHIPPED, PACKED, DELIVERED).

production_status.description: Production status filter (e.g. NOT_STARTED, IN_PROGRESS, DONE).

created_at_min.description: Created on or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

created_at_max.description: Created on or before this ISO 8601 date-time.

tools.name: katana_get_sales_order
tools.title: Get a sales order
tools.description: Get one sales order by id, with its rows and addresses. Katana API: GET /sales_orders/{id}.

tools.name: katana_list_manufacturing_orders
tools.title: List manufacturing orders
tools.description: List manufacturing orders (production jobs), most recent first. Katana API: GET /manufacturing_orders.

status.description: Order status filter (e.g. NOT_STARTED, IN_PROGRESS, DONE).

location_id.description: Only orders at this location id.

is_linked_to_sales_order.description: Only orders linked (true) or not linked (false) to a sales order.

tools.name: katana_get_manufacturing_order
tools.title: Get a manufacturing order
tools.description: Get one manufacturing order by id, with recipe and operation rows. Katana API: GET /manufacturing_orders/{id}.

tools.name: katana_list_purchase_orders
tools.title: List purchase orders
tools.description: List purchase orders to suppliers, filterable by status, supplier, location or billing status. Katana API: GET /purchase_orders.

supplier_id.description: Only orders with this supplier id.

location_id.description: Only orders for this location id.

tools.name: katana_get_purchase_order
tools.title: Get a purchase order
tools.description: Get one purchase order by id, with its rows. Katana API: GET /purchase_orders/{id}.

tools.name: katana_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (name, company, email, phone, currency). Katana API: GET /customers.

tools.name: katana_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers (name, email, phone, addresses). Katana API: GET /suppliers.

tools.name: katana_list_inventory
tools.title: List stock levels
tools.description: List current stock levels per variant and location (in stock, committed, expected). Katana API: GET /inventory.

tools.name: katana_list_inventory_movements
tools.title: List inventory movements
tools.description: List stock movements (what changed, when, and which order caused it). Katana API: GET /inventory_movements.

variant_ids.description: Only movements of these variant ids.

resource_type.description: Resource type that caused the movement (e.g. SALES_ORDER).

caused_by_order_no.description: Only movements caused by this order number.

tools.name: katana_list_negative_stock
tools.title: List variants with negative stock
tools.description: List variants whose stock balance went negative, with the date of the latest negative movement. Katana API: GET /negative_stock.

tools.name: katana_list_stock_adjustments
tools.title: List stock adjustments
tools.description: List stock adjustments (manual corrections to stock at a location). Katana API: GET /stock_adjustments.

tools.name: katana_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List locations (warehouses, factories, shops) with their flags for sales, manufacturing and purchasing. Katana API: GET /locations.

tools.name: katana_get_location
tools.title: Get a location
tools.description: Get one location by id. Katana API: GET /locations/{id}.

tools.name: katana_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a customer record in Katana. Only `name` is required. This changes account data. Katana API: POST /customers.

first_name.description: First name of the contact person.

last_name.description: Last name of the contact person.

currency.description: Currency code, e.g. EUR or USD.

tools.name: katana_create_sales_order
tools.title: Create a sales order
tools.description: Create a sales order for an existing customer, with one or more rows (variant and quantity). The order and its rows are created together. This changes account data. Katana API: POST /sales_orders.

price_per_unit.description: Unit price; omit to use the variant's sales price.

order_no.description: Order number; Katana assigns one if omitted.

location_id.description: Location id the order ships from.

additional_info.description: Free text shown on the order.

tools.name: katana_create_manufacturing_order
tools.title: Create a manufacturing order
tools.description: Create a manufacturing order (production job) for a producible variant at a location. Katana fills the recipe and operation rows from the product recipe. This changes account data. Katana API: POST /manufacturing_orders.

order_no.description: Order number; Katana assigns one if omitted.

additional_info.description: Free text note on the order.
